title: Aquatic licences
summary: This page provides information about aquatic licences, including how to apply for one and manage related certificates.

internal_links.text: Change address and contact details on an aquatic event licence

faqs.q: How do I apply for an aquatic licence?
faqs.a: You can apply for an aquatic licence using the dedicated application page.

faqs.q: What if I need to replace my aquatic licence certificate?
faqs.a: You can replace your aquatic licence certificate through the online service.

faqs.q: How do I change my address or contact details for an aquatic event licence?
faqs.a: You can update your details using the online service for aquatic event licences.
